normalization.axes: glTF node matrices already give +Y up with the gun toward +z; recipe axes x,y,z
normalization.why: 0.92 puts the skirt width at 3.70 m (raw 4.02 m over the front skirt planes); the translation seats the lowest track vertex on y = 0 and centres the structural hull (raw stern plate z -3.731 … nose z 3.994) on z = 0
normalization.method: Welded-vertex island census, axis-aligned first-hit depth maps at 1 cm and normal-shaded orthographic renders (.qa-dev/ztz100-source-study.mjs, .qa-dev/ztz100-shaded.mjs); scalars only

hullM.upperGlacis: one plane from the roof edge (z 1.00, y 1.46 at the shoulders, 1.39 on the centreline) to the nose (z 3.56, y 1.20); tiled appliqué field

notes: Seven road wheels a side, drive at the rear, small idler at the front, two return rollers.
Two cylindrical sensor/launcher towers on the turret front roof corners, a tall weapon station at the rear centre, a missile bank on the right cheek, a slat cage across the stern.
All values are the game frame after the recipe: metres, +Y up, +Z forward, ground y = 0, structural hull centred on z = 0.
